title: OpenClaw vs ChatGPT: What's Actually Different (and Why It Matters)
summary: ChatGPT answers questions when you ask. OpenClaw takes actions while you sleep. Here's the real difference between AI chatbots and AI agents — and when each wins.
body_markdown: Neither is inherently smarter. Both can use the same underlying models — Claude Opus 4.5, GPT-4o, Gemini. The architectural difference is what matters: OpenClaw runs those models in an agentic loop with scheduling, tools, and persistent memory. ChatGPT runs them in a conversational interface. For autonomous tasks, the agentic architecture wins. Blink Claw gives you a choice of 13 AI models, with usage billed from your workspace credits on top of the agent's machine (from about $45/month).
